description: SoundFingerprinting.Emy is a native C# client for Emy fingerprints storage. It provides ways to insert, query, delete entries from Emy. To learn more about SoundFingerprinting visit github page https://github.com/AddictedCS/soundfingerprinting. To learn more about Emy visit https://www.emysound.com
releaseNotes:
Version 15.17.0
        - Added EmyClient (IEmyClient, IEmyClientFactory, EmyClientFactory): one client owns the connections to an Emy server or a leader/follower pair and exposes focused services: Models (IEmyModels), Streams (IStreamingContentSearcher), Matches (IEmyMatches), Duplicates (ICrossValidationMatchRegistry) and Ads (IAdsRegistry). Services borrow the client's connections; dispose the client, not the services.
        - EmyModelService and IEmyModelService are unchanged: EmyModelService now forwards every call to one owned EmyClient, with the same routing, validation and results.
        - Disposing a client while a connection attempt is in flight now releases the pending socket instead of leaving it open until garbage collection.
        - Breaking change (intentional source and binary compatibility break): removed the client-side sharding API in the SoundFingerprinting.Emy.Sharding namespace: ShardingModelService, IShardInsertStrategy, LoadShardInsertStrategy and RoundRobinStrategy. There is no replacement.
        Version 15.16.0
        - Updated SoundFingerprinting to 15.16.0: FFmpegAudioService crops a frame region out of the decoded frames of every file when the video fingerprint configuration carries an IFrameCropSink (VideoFingerprintConfiguration.FrameCropSink, AVFingerprintConfiguration.WithFrameCropSink).
        - FFmpegAudioService has one public constructor, FFmpegAudioService(ILoggerFactory?); SupportedFormats now lists the demuxer names of the loaded FFmpeg build (read once, lazily) instead of a static list.
        - AVStreamingPublishOptions.MediaServiceFactory is Func<string, IMediaService>; the publish worker hands its frame crop sink to the media service through the fingerprint configuration.
        Version 15.14.1
        - Updated SoundFingerprinting to 15.14.1 to recover retrospective cut-off occurrences, retain fixed-axis matching, and remove timestamp-origin-dependent match selection.
        Version 15.3.0
        - Updated SoundFingerprinting dependency to 15.3.0 (ComputeSpectralProfile now defaults to true, so fingerprinted tracks carry the per-second spectral profile out of the box).
        Version 15.2.0
        - Updated SoundFingerprinting dependency to 15.2.0 (MatchedWithType provenance on matches, TruePositivesFilter.ignoreBridgedCoverage, SilenceBridgingStrategy rename).
        - SimilarTracksQuery's true-positives filter now ignores bridged coverage by default — only real fingerprint anchors count toward the coverage bar — so spectral bridging can no longer inflate a coincidental cross-advertiser match over the threshold. 
        Version 15.1.0
        - Updated SoundFingerprinting dependency to 15.1.0 (windowed spectral-profile bridging, order-independent CompositeBridgingStrategy, per-strategy bridge caps).
        - SimilarTracksQuery now bridges noisy/quiet gaps with the windowed broadband + silent composite, fully recovering cross-station ad matches that previously matched only partially.
        Version 15.0.9
        - Updated SoundFingerprinting dependency to 15.0.9 (fixed Hashes.GetRange for spectral profiles)
        Version 15.0.4
        - Fixed FFmpegTranscoder JIFF marker update
        Version 15.0.0
        - Upgraded SoundFingerprinting dependency to 15.0.0
        Version 14.0.0
        - Upgraded SoundFingerprinting dependency to 14.0.0
        - Updated FFmpeg.AutoGen to v8.0.0
        Version 12.7.0
        - Updated SoundFingerprinting dependency to 12.7.0
